description.default: Publish a document as a byte-identical SiYuan HTML folder to WebDAV / FTP / SFTP / a local folder, with incremental upload, dry run, publish dashboard, change detection and unpublish.
description.zh_CN: 一键将文档以「HTML (SiYuan)」格式发布到 WebDAV / FTP / SFTP 服务器或本地目录：增量上传、试算、发布看板、改动检测、重新发布与取消发布；双链、块嵌入与图片资产全部保留。
